_README: External high-frequency dielectric constants (eps_inf) for the Wannier-Mott exciton binding (Theme I, option c). Extracted ONLY from in-repo references/pdfs (no fabricated values). See cowork/progress 2026-05-24 Y1c1 note. Most CsBX3 eps_inf are NOT present in the in-repo literature -> status 'not_found_in_references'; PI decision requested (provide values / authorize external DFT-RPA+experimental lookup / exclude).
_searched_texts: references/texts/*.txt (61 files), grep for high-frequency/optical dielectric, epsilon_inf, refractive index, per material

CsPbI3.source: Cho et al. 2019, arXiv:1908.09436 (text line ~224, 'epsilon = 6.1'); also Bhattacharya-type NC paper arXiv:2210.01324 (lines 119/190, 'dielectric constant eps_p = 6.1', stated as bulk MAPbI3 high-frequency dielectric)
CsPbI3.method: effective exciton screening (eps_p) used in BSE/Wannier-Mott for lead-iodide perovskite
CsPbI3.notes: NOT a measured CsPbI3 eps_inf. It is the EFFECTIVE dielectric (between eps_inf and eps_static) used for the MAPbI3-type lead-iodide exciton. Used here only as a rough proxy for CsPbI3; flag in any E_b output. Do not treat as material-specific eps_inf.
